name: Jest Messters
source:
What if you're cursed to make others laugh?

The 'Jester' is an entity who grants children happiness, but he was just another persona of myth... Until one day he appears on your windowsill and bestows his powers upon you. 

Now you're stuck with a pun-curse and sadly, zero friends who share your sense of humor.


A few years later, you are transferred to the prestigious Marney High, where you meet a bunch of quirky classmates– some who might be just as weird as you.

But be careful who you trust. As sinister plots start to unravel around you, you find yourself tangled in a web of secrets and schemes. And maybe... your curse is the key to solve them all?

[From [url=https://elseth.itch.io/jest-messters]itch.io[/url]]
